#define H1_ORDER 3

static const double H1_B[4] = { -0.04707910647011415, 0.14012187769328976, -0.13900395190612658, 0.04596118852815667 };
static const double H1_A[4] = { 1.0, -2.863322645800251, 2.7304639513506865, -0.8671197273400103 };  /* A[0] == 1 */

typedef struct {
    double u[H1_ORDER];  /* u[0] = u[k-1], u[1] = u[k-2], ... */
    double y[H1_ORDER];  /* y[0] = y[k-1], y[1] = y[k-2], ... */
} H1_State;

static inline double H1_process(H1_State *s, double u0)
{
    double y0 = H1_B[0] * u0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= H1_ORDER; i++)
        y0 += H1_B[i] * s->u[i - 1] - H1_A[i] * s->y[i - 1];
    for (int i = H1_ORDER - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        s->u[i] = s->u[i - 1];
        s->y[i] = s->y[i - 1];
    }
    s->u[0] = u0;
    s->y[0] = y0;
    return y0;
}
